S0843.reason: A remainder to the grantor's own heirs is void under the doctrine of worthier title, leaving Friend a life estate and Owner a reversion; Shelley's Case would apply only if the remainder were to Friend's heirs.

S0065.reason: Under the ICJ Nicaragua scale-and-effects test, Article 51 'armed attack' means only the gravest, high-intensity uses of force, not every use of force, every terrorist act, or a right to invade.

S0157.reason: A bladder washout is used to clear debris or encrustation when an indwelling catheter is blocked; clear urine, external dirt, or bypassing alone are not the indication.
